status: Revision 2 passes isolated seated, sleeping and looking frame-fit review. Internal development only; not a public appearance option.
scope: Base poses 12–15 and idle poses 0–3. Together with prior work, twenty of 48 main facial poses have reviewed bindings; return poses remain open.
rejectedSource: Revision 1 passed broad bounds checks but failed actual seated/sleeping face review: generic widened curves and floating cheek tips. None of its poses is promoted. Its source, registrations and failed visual comparisons are retained.
acceptedSource: Revision 2 was generated from actual face/mask guides. Its cheek and jaw curves follow the narrower seated/sleeping faces and looking poses in the inspected comparisons. No raster trimming, warping, alpha fitting or source-crop resizing was used to conceal the failed source.
inspected: 48 original/composed hairstyle, skin-palette and pose comparisons: 18 sitting, 6 sleeping and 24 looking.
All eight frames in both facings, day/night tint, small/enlarged actual resident-renderer samples.
72 ordered temporal comparisons including the seated lean/return, held sleeping frame over elapsed times and looking loop. This is not full continuous-playback or cross-activity motion acceptance.
mechanical: Revision 2 passes the existing 98 percent authored-region gate using guide-measured bounds plus a twelve-source-pixel margin. One pose has five thresholded source pixels outside that envelope; its measured coverage is recorded in sit-v2-report.json. The other seven have complete envelope coverage.
No pixels outside the authored face crop change in all 48 combinations.
Each of the three clips refuses 16 invalid source-tile, pose-set, clip and pose requests; the unused ninth tile is empty.
18 provider disposal checks and three instrumented failed-construction cleanup checks pass. Partially allocated canvas surfaces are cleared before errors escape.
Cache limits follow actual unique poses: sit 3 frames / 786432 composed RGBA bytes; sleep 1 / 262144; look 4 / 1048576. Decoded source/body/GPU memory is outside this measurement.
Earlier walking, breathing, working and sprite-frame regressions pass. Candidate revision is mandatory in the shared verifier, preventing an accidental default to a rejected revision.
tools: prepare-facial-pose-guides.mjs validates fixed face/tile bounds, unique pose keys, non-overlapping integer source tiles and measured guide paint bounds. verify-facial-clips.mjs handles base/idle sheets and varying clip lengths using the actual animation catalog/timing.
